name: 75904 · Lufkin, TX
findings: ZIP 75904 (Lufkin) has 90 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75904 (Lufkin) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 11 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
